case_name: A 60-second single take that the free plan has to make in two generations: does the second continue the first?
title: Night ride, a 60 s single take
tests: Tests continuity across a length the free plan cannot make in one generation on every model: whether the second clip continues the first without a visible seam (the same rider, jacket, bike, weather and light), and whether the piece reads as one take.

faults.what: The soundtrack contains the spoken sentence "The baby was sleeping.", directly violating the ambient-sound-only and no-speech requirements.

judge.summary: The sampled frames show a consistent yellow-jacketed courier riding through wet nighttime streets, but prohibited speech spoils the soundtrack and the requested opening and ending cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: One continuous take: no visible cut, jump or change of scene anywhere, including at the midpoint.
must_haves.why: The four frames are compatible with a continuous tracking shot, but cannot establish that there are no cuts or camera jumps between them.

must_haves.item: The same rider in the same yellow rain jacket on the same bike from the first second to the last.
must_haves.why: The rider, yellow jacket, helmet, courier bag and bicycle appear consistent across the samples, but the first and last seconds and intervening motion are not shown.

must_haves.item: It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends with her stopping at the lit door of a small café and stepping off the bike.
must_haves.why: Neither endpoint is supplied. All four samples show street riding; none shows a bridge crossing or a café stop and dismount.

must_haves.item: Rain and night throughout, with consistent light.
must_haves.why: All samples show nighttime streets with wet, reflective surfaces and plausible street lighting, but ongoing rainfall throughout the clip cannot be established.
The reported duration is 59.1 seconds, and the supplied frames are approximately 16:9 with a live-action appearance.

must_haves.item: Ambient sound only: no music, no speech, no text on screen.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio transcription explicitly reports speech: "The baby was sleeping." No added text overlays are visible in the sampled frames.
